messages:
mira: quick sync  scheduling cross-service deploy tonight 23:00 UTC. targets: api:v2026-03-22.1, runtime:2.3.1, router:0.9.5, console:1.12.1. final sign-off on pins and rollback rules?

sam: please lock runtime to 2.3.1 for hosted + dedicated. last 2.3.x caused KV eviction spikes on long seqs; fallback runtime:2.2.8.

jordan: console minor CSS bundle change only; no schema migrations. router header-split toggle will be controlled by canary policy. sequence: api -> runtime -> router -> console.

mira: proposed canary: 5% x15m, 25% x10m, then 100%. stagger steps 60s.

rita: rollback criteria (auto):
- API 5xx >0.5% sustained over 5m
- p50 increase >75ms over baseline for 10m
- runtime OOM or kv-evict >3x baseline OR >10 uncaught exceptions/min
Manual abort: `/deploy abort <run-id>`; incident notify to #incidents.

sam: add console visual check (grep for `render_error`) and alert devex if function/tooling fails. note: kernel-quant will be enabled only in canary; watch tokenization diffs and KV miss rate.

mira: pins set: runtime:2.3.1 (fallback 2.2.8), console:1.12.1, router:0.9.5, api:v2026-03-22.1.

jordan: adding route rule to force 0% traffic to new console if error_rate >1% (failback to previous). injecting into canary policy.

mira: deploy command I'll run:
```
/deploy orchestrate \
  --services api,runtime,router,console \
  --canary 5 --canary-duration 15m \
  --staged 25,100 --stagger 60s \
  --pin runtime:2.3.1 --fallback runtime:2.2.8 \
  --tag v2026-03-22.1
```

deploy-bot: scheduled orchestrated deploy (run-id:20260322-01) by mira at 2026-03-22T23:00:00Z. Canary plan set; auto-rollback thresholds from thread.

rita: adding runbook link and will escalate to on-call if auto-rollback triggers. include sample traces in p95 alerts.

mira: starting in ~20m. hold here to stop.

jordan: ready, monitoring hooks and quick rollback command prepped.

deploy-bot: run 20260322-01: canary started for api and runtime. 5% traffic routed to new variants. Monitoring active.

mira: thanks team — watch channels and ping if any noisy signals.

rita: quick abort snippet for runbook:
```
/deploy abort 20260322-01 --reason "auto-threshold"
/deploy promote fallback --services runtime --version 2.2.8
```

sam: will add brief note to release_notes about console bundle tweak and kernel-quant toggle.

mira: will update release_notes.md after run with observed metrics and follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
